# Clinchd

> Clinchd is an AI-powered Instagram DM automation platform built specifically for coaches and course creators. It replaces manual DM setters and rigid flow-based tools like ManyChat with AI-native conversations that qualify leads, handle objections, and book discovery calls automatically. Pricing starts at $97/month with no per-contact fees.

Clinchd uses the official Meta Graph API to respond to inbound Instagram DMs. The AI is trained on each coach's specific offer details, brand voice, qualification criteria, and objection-handling style. It operates 24/7, responding to new leads within seconds, and hands off warm qualified prospects to the coach for closing.

## Key Features

- AI-powered DM conversations that sound human and match the coach's brand voice
- Comment-to-DM automation (trigger keywords on Reels and posts)
- Story reply automation
- Lead qualification with customizable criteria (budget, timeline, fit)
- Dynamic objection handling based on context
- Automatic discovery call booking with calendar integration
- Real-time analytics dashboard with conversation insights and lead scores
- Human takeover with one click at any point in a conversation
- Flat monthly pricing with no per-contact or per-message fees
- Full Meta Graph API compliance (inbound only, no spam, no cold outreach)

## Target Audience

Online coaches, consultants, and course creators with 5K to 100K+ Instagram followers who sell high-ticket offers ($500 to $15,000+) and generate leads through Instagram content and DMs.

## Pricing

- Base plan: $97/month (500 DMs/month, AI setter, lead qualification, auto-booking)
- Unlimited plan: $197/month (unlimited DMs, advanced analytics, priority support, custom AI tuning)
- 7-day free trial, no credit card required

## Comparisons

- [Clinchd vs ManyChat](https://www.clinchd.io/compare/vs-manychat): ManyChat uses per-contact pricing and rigid flow builders. Clinchd uses flat pricing and AI-native conversations.
- [Clinchd vs GoHighLevel](https://www.clinchd.io/compare/vs-gohighlevel): GoHighLevel is an all-in-one platform with shallow Instagram DM features. Clinchd is purpose-built for Instagram DM automation.
- [Clinchd vs Setter AI](https://www.clinchd.io/compare/vs-setter-ai): Setter AI focuses on phone and email outreach. Clinchd is built for Instagram-first coaches.
